# Scoped PRIMARY bytes route

This route preserves the original bce PRIMARY FAIL and evaluates only the
approved observed bytes increase. It authenticates the fixed original ZIP and
its samples, derives program identities from those authenticated bytes, and
requires exact identity-only rebuilds and a fresh exact-run owner decision.
All other jobs and the ordinary raw comparison remain required. M0 approval
for original bce does not transfer. Expiry is exclusive, follow-up issue 5396.

The route is source-only until independently reviewed and qualified on the
actual hosted current head; it does not itself certify a successful run.
